name: task-problems
description: Errors and warnings from task output (compilers, linters, test runners) in the Problems view and as underlines in open files.

showInEditor.title: Show in Editors
showInEditor.description: Underline task problems in open files and mark their lines. Off: they're only listed in the Problems view.

matchers.title: Custom Matchers
matchers.description: Your own formats, as regular expressions with named groups file, line and optionally column, severity, message and code: { "mytool": "^(?<file>[^:]+):(?<line>\\d+): (?<message>.*)$" }, or { "mytool": { "pattern": "…", "severity": "warning" } }. They're tried before the built-in ones.
